title: Dual-write consistency validator for Prometheus + OTLP inference KPIs
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: We run dual-write for several inference KPIs (OTLP -> tracing pipeline, and Prometheus scrape/adapter for real-time dashboards). Drift between the two paths causes mismatched SLOs, alert storms, and debugging overhead. This ticket implements a lightweight validator service and integration tests that detect semantic inconsistencies between the OTLP-derived KPI stream and the Prometheus-exported metrics.
acceptance_criteria: A headless validator service receives event-level samples from both OTLP ingest and Prometheus scrape snapshots and computes per-key consistency metrics (count parity, latency quantiles alignment, tag cardinality mismatches)
Validator emits daily and on-demand reports to the observability console with diff highlights and example request IDs for divergence > 1%
Automated CI job that runs on PRs validates no new schema or label drift for the last 30 days of test data
Integration test harness included in repo with mock OTLP and Prometheus inputs and a stable golden output
On divergence detection: create an annotated incident draft with suggested remediation steps and a link to related dashboards
